contribution_requirements: There is no README, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or .kiro/steering/* in this repo - the only docs are docs/mqtt-plugin-guide.md, an empty info.md, and the spec under .kiro/specs/mqtt-broker-connected-system/. The governing requirements are Appian's AppMarket plug-in policies: source code must be contained within the executable jar; plug-in packages must not be com.appian.* or com.appiancorp.*; logging only through Log4j; no System.setProperty or JVM-global mutation; Closeables explicitly closed and temp files deleted; no manual filesystem access; no hardcoded credentials; no copyleft libraries; no SNAPSHOT versions; the manifest must sit at the jar root. Do NOT rewrite docs/mqtt-plugin-guide.md or info.md wholesale - make only the targeted fixes each FEAT names.
key_patterns: Appian SDK packages are com.appian.connectedsystems.* and com.appiancorp.* - a blind find-and-replace of 'com.appian' WILL corrupt SDK imports; only the project's own com.appian.mqtt is renamed. The three registered classes carry @TemplateId(name=...) equal to their simple class names, and resources_en_US.properties keys use those SIMPLE class names ([SimpleClassName].name / .description / .[fieldKey].label), case sensitive - a mismatch deploys silently but never registers the template. MqttConnectedSystemTemplate implements the low-level ConnectedSystemTemplate interface and both integrations implement IntegrationTemplate (NOT the Simple* base classes) - that is deliberate and OUT OF SCOPE to change. Request policies are already correct: Publish is @IntegrationTemplateType(IntegrationTemplateRequestPolicy.WRITE), Subscribe is READ. Field keys come from de.hock.mqtt.validation.ConfigFields as the single source of truth. Validation returns ValidationResult objects rather than throwing; sensitive values are held in char[] and redacted by diagnostics/Redactor. TLS is built as an in-memory SSLContext and handed to Paho via options.setSocketFactory(...) in ConnectOptionsFactory - never via system properties.
